source_evidence.asset_dimensions: Pinned Factory Peg8mm diameter .007986 m, Hole8mm diameter .0081 m; radial clearance .000057 m

checkpoint_selection_rationale: Stock contact penalty begins at 5 N; low change in the geometric reward over consecutive four-step windows defines stagnation independently of Q.
tolerance_rationale: Position equivalence uses half the nominal radial clearance; rotation-matrix/joint tolerances 0.0005 correspond to small-angle motion of order 25 micrometres at a 50 mm peg. Gripper prismatic coordinates and velocities are measured separately from rotary arm joints. Force/torque use raw 120 Hz sampled step averages. These are engineering equivalence tests, not error bounds.
directions: Unit-norm K=4 repeated +z or +x, each step coefficient .5; pre-EMA target increments .5 or 1.25 mm before stock controller clipping.

short_gate.heldout_prediction_improvement: validation-parent contrast MSE reduction >=10% and paired 95% upper bound <0

scope: Locked before ACT training, D0/D1, held-out diagnostics and ACT validation. No tuning from test outcomes.
